info.descrizione: Shipping and returns, terms of sale, privacy, cookies and legal notes of Ninni & Ernesto.
info.bozza: Demo texts: a lawyer must review them before the site goes live.
info.sped_intro: We check and pack every print by hand. Unframed prints travel in a rigid tube, framed ones in a crate. Tracking arrives by email.
info.tab_nota: Editions: per piece. Prints: once per order. Business days from shipping.
info.preparazione: Before shipping: limited editions {o} business days, prints {s}.
info.resi: You have 14 days from delivery to return a print: write to us before shipping it and we will tell you how to pack it.
termini: Ninni & Ernesto, [company name and address to complete].
Prints are pigment on archival paper. Limited editions have a fixed number of copies, signed and numbered by hand, with a certificate. Colors on screen may look slightly different.
In euro. Shipping shows in the cart before you pay.
The contract is concluded with the confirmation email. Payment by card through Stripe, or in 3 installments.
If a copy of the edition turns out to be already sold after your order, we tell you and refund you in full.
You have 14 days from delivery to withdraw without giving a reason. It does not apply to custom sizes.
Buying a print does not include the right to reproduce it: that stays with the photographer.
privacy: Name, contacts and address when you buy; what you write in the forms; your email if you ask to be notified.
To handle orders, deliveries and invoices, and to answer your messages.
Only those who need it: courier, Stripe, accountant, website and email providers.
Order data for as long as tax law requires; the rest until you ask us to delete it.
You can see, correct or delete your data by writing to ciao@ninnieernesto.example, or contact the Italian data protection authority.
info.cookie: Necessary cookies make the cart, language and checkout work. Statistics cookies only start if you accept them: this demo has none.
info.diritti: Photographs and texts © Ninni & Ernesto: no reproduction without permission.
info.demo: Demo site: no real payments, no orders, no emails sent.

cookie.testo: We use technical cookies for the cart and, only if you allow it, cookies to see which pages are visited.

carte.descrizione: The fine art papers and frames we use for prints and limited editions, with prices.
carte.lead: We print with pigment inks on cotton and Japanese papers. We check every print ourselves before it leaves.
carte.ed_1: 7 to 10 copies per photograph, plus 1 or 2 artist’s proofs. When they are gone, no more are printed.
carte.ed_2: Each copy is signed and numbered by hand on the back and comes with its certificate.
carte.ed_3: The first copies cost less: the price rises in steps as the edition sells.
carte.ed_4: It arrives framed, ready to hang.
